if: interest, late fee or penalty is charged for delayed payment of any consideration for any supply
then: it is INCLUDED in the value of supply
note: Interest on a late-paying customer is part of the taxable value, not a financing item outside GST. Its TIME of supply is separate — s.12(6) / s.13(6) put it on the date the supplier receives it (GST-TIME-GOODS-009, GST-TIME-SERVICES-012).

evidence.quote: interest or late fee or penalty for delayed payment of any consideration for any supply
